{{Top|leg}}
The '''advanced stun ray''' was a special aftermarket modification of the standard [[Quellegh Industrial]] [[stun ray]]. As this device was very expensive to produce, it had been used primarily by government-sponsored elite troops.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
